name: El Paso (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, green and black, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of El Paso (a mountain and a pine above a river).
history: The flag of the municipality was approved by the same order of 1994 as the heraldic arms, published in the Boletín Oficial de Canarias of 27 April 1994; its official description is a rectangular flag one and a half times as long as wide, divided into three stripes of equal size of white, green and black in that order, with the arms at the centre of the cloth.

features.role: El Paso arms — mountain on red and pine above a river on yellow
yellow field and crown of the arms
